Plot SVG Rank Against SVG Statistic

Source: R/svg_marker.R
plot_svg_rank_vs_stat.Rd

Visualises the relationship between SVG statistics and SVG ranks for selected genes across normalisation methods.

Usage

plot_svg_rank_vs_stat(
  svg_norm,
  genes,
  stat = "LR_stat",
  method_order = NULL,
  method_colors = NULL,
  transform = c("log1p", "log", "none"),
  scales = c("fixed", "free", "free_x", "free_y"),
  ncol = NULL,
  nrow = NULL,
  point_size = 3,
  gene_id = "rownames",
  theme_name = "classic"
)

Arguments

svg_norm

Named list of SVG results.

genes

Genes to plot.

stat

SVG statistic. Default is "LR_stat".

method_order

Optional method order.

method_colors

Optional named vector of method colours.

transform

Transformation: log1p, log, or none.

scales

Facet scales: fixed, free, free_x, or free_y.

ncol

Number of facet columns.

nrow

Number of facet rows.

point_size

Point size.

gene_id

Gene identifier.

theme_name

Plot theme.

Value

A list containing data and plot.

Details

Each point represents a normalisation method, with genes displayed in separate facets.

Examples

data(svg_example)

marker_genes <- head(rownames(svg_example[[1]]), 5)

p <- plot_svg_rank_vs_stat(
  svg_norm = svg_example,
  genes = marker_genes,
  stat = "LR_stat",
  transform = "log"
)

p$plot
